body.x: ECORENEW Inc. (CEO Dukhyun Choi) announced its participation in CES 2025 at the K-Startup Pavilion in Las Vegas, USA, from January 7 to 10, 2025.

ECORENEW is a South Korean company founded on over 20 years of research and development in nano surface treatment and nano filter technologies. Its proprietary advanced nano filters rapidly and accurately separate water and oil from industrial wastewater, minimizing resource waste and accelerating ESG management goals.

The company’s continuous oil-water separator has been praised for addressing oversized equipment, lengthy processing times, and odor production associated with traditional buoyancy-based systems. Using highly hydrophilic and hydrophobic nano-level filters, the separator achieves high-quality water-oil separation, facilitating recycling while reducing wastewater treatment costs and promoting resource circulation.

ECORENEW will unveil its industrial oil-water separator, RenewFLOW, at CES 2025. This product delivers rapid separation with exceptional processing speed and stability. Its compact, modular design improves space efficiency by over 80%, making it suitable for various industrial applications.

body.cap: Nano filters applied in RenewFLOW | Image provided by ECORENEW

body.x: RenewFLOW has an intelligent automated control system that analyzes sensor data to maintain oil-water separation efficiency of up to 99.99%. This ensures reduced maintenance costs, enhanced operational reliability, and optimal equipment quality.

The separated water and oil can be immediately recycled, enabling companies to comply with increasingly stringent environmental regulations. Additionally, the closed and automated process minimizes workers’ exposure to hazardous substances, enhancing workplace safety.

An ECORENEW representative described RenewFLOW as a next-generation solution based on four key values: high efficiency, reliability, safety, and eco-friendliness. The nano filters utilized in RenewFLOW feature a polymer ligand bonded to micro-nano structures, allowing precise control of oil properties and achieving instant separation of water and oil with over 99.99% efficiency.

The representative added, “Through CES, we aim to showcase our equipment’s advanced technology and functionality to domestic and international partners and potential customers. We aim to strengthen ECORENEW’s brand value and market presence as a global leader in fostering a sustainable business ecosystem.”
